wire_contract.in_words: Neither copy of PerformanceReport.schema.json (the v1 docs copy and the lambda _contracts copy) enumerates the members of optional_facts.value_facts: it is typed object-or-null with no properties, and its description says only 'start and end values only when supported'. Both fixtures carry value_facts as null. No other contract file under docs/contracts/investor-reporting/ or _contracts/ (CONTRACT.md, REQUEST_COMPOSITION.md, the other schemas, examples, responses, fixtures) contains any of the six names or any beginning/ending/opening/closing wording for the value. The contract is open on the two names.

emitters.in_words: The holdings-basis producer writes the first and last status-OK account value of the window into value_facts as start_value and end_value.
The 49F engine writes the first linked day's beginning value and the last linked day's ending value into value_facts as start_value and end_value (with net_additions).
The Orion adapter writes the vendor calculated-activity startValue and endValue into value_facts as start_value and end_value.
The Black Diamond adapter is the only emitter writing the beginning/ending market value names into value_facts, from the vendor point's beginningMarketValue and endingMarketValue.
A narrative fixture of a served-shape report carries value_facts with start_value and end_value; a fixture, not a live emitter.
